decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall begin not later than three years from the date of this decision.
Reason: In order to comply with Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990, as amended by Section 51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications: [0233-2406-L-001 r1, 0233-2406-L-100P, 0233-2406-L-200 P, 0233-2406-L-210 P, 0233-2406-L-220 P, 2038-T-511, 0233-3406 300 (Planting palette), 05714_E_00_01(T01), ID0721_NB, Design and Access Statement, Fire Exemption Statement, application form � Received 05/12/2025].
Reason: In order to ensure the development is carried out in accordance with the planning permission.

Condition : 3 - Notwithstanding the submitted details, the sound emitted during power outages or testing by the standby or emergency generators hereby approved shall not exceed the lowest daytime ambient noise level LAeq(15min) as measured or calculated according to BS4142:2014. For the purpose of testing, testing is permitted for up to 1 hour per month between 09.00 and 17.00 Monday to Friday only and not on public holidays.
Reason: To ensure that the proposed development does not prejudice the amenities of occupiers of neighbouring properties.
description: Installation of a new emergency generator and control box with associated building works and landscaping.
